name: Surface Water Grants
summary: Annual cost-sharing grants in Wisconsin for lake and river protection and restoration: planning, shoreland and watershed restoration practices, aquatic invasive species control and permanent land protection. Nonprofit conservation organisations and lake or river associations apply after an eligibility review.

calls.label: 2026 application round

status.quote: Surface Water Grant final applications are due on November 16th, 2026.

deadline.quote: Surface Water Grant final applications are due on November 16th, 2026.

calls.note: Applies to applicants seeking CBCW or LMPN funds and those who already submitted the required pre-application for other grant types

applicant_types.quote: tribal governing bodies, other local units of government, accredited colleges, universities, technical schools, lake districts and town sanitary districts are automatically eligible to apply for a Surface Water Grant. Qualified lake associations, qualified surface water management organizations, qualified river management organizations, nonprofit conservation organizations

access.quote: The preferred method of application submittal is via email to DNRSurfaceWaterGrants@wisconsin.gov.

co_finance_required.quote: provides cost-sharing grants for surface water protection and restoration
